Storm in UP's Firozabad kills five after tree falls on e-rickshaw

A severe storm in Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh, caused a large neem tree to fall on an e-rickshaw and a motorcycle. The incident resulted in the deaths of five people and injuries to three others. Local villagers used cutters to clear the debris, and the administration announced financial aid for the victims' families.
